name: MonarchStatCard
title: StatCard
wrapsNative: MonarchMetric (Text with Foundation format styles) on the MonarchCard surface, with MonarchInfoTooltip (popover), MonarchSparkline, Button with a plain style for the drill-down, .redacted(reason: .placeholder) while loading, MonarchInlineErrorRetry
summary: One KPI for a dashboard: a MonarchMetric (label, value, unit and change) on a card, with an optional hint, an explanation behind an info button, a trend sparkline and a drill-down.
whenToUse: On a dashboard or overview screen, for a headline number people scan and may open for the detail behind it. Several sit in a MonarchDashboardGrid or a LazyVGrid.
whenNotToUse: For a number inside a row, a header or a table footer use MonarchMetric on its own. For a chart with axes use the chart components.
api: init(_ label: String, value: Double?, unit: String? = nil, change: MonarchMetricChange? = nil, format: MonarchMetricFormat = .number, isCompact: Bool = false, hint: String? = nil, help: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, sparkline: [Double?]? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, variant: MonarchStatCardVariant = .card, size: MonarchMetricSize = .md, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, emptyLabel: String? = nil, helpLabel: String? = nil, loadingLabel: String? = nil, action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

init(_ label: String, text: String?, spokenText: String? = nil, unit: String? = nil, change: MonarchMetricChange? = nil, hint: String? = nil, help: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, sparkline: [Double?]? = nil, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, variant: MonarchStatCardVariant = .card, size: MonarchMetricSize = .md, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, emptyLabel: String? = nil, helpLabel: String? = nil, loadingLabel: String? = nil, action: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: label
options.description: What the number measures. Always visible.

options.name: value
options.description: The number, formatted by MonarchMetric. nil shows a dash read as No data.

options.name: text
options.description: In the second initialiser: the value as the app wrote it, such as "4.8 / 5".

options.name: spokenText
options.description: What VoiceOver reads for a text value when it differs from the text.

options.name: unit
options.description: A unit written smaller after the value.

options.name: change
options.description: The change versus an earlier period, drawn by MonarchDeltaIndicator with its comparison and good direction.

options.name: format
options.description: A plain number, a percentage of a ratio, or a currency.

options.name: isCompact
options.description: Writes 1.2K or €3.4M; VoiceOver reads the full value.

options.name: hint
options.description: A caption under the value, such as "38 of 52 people". Say here why a tone is set.

options.name: help
options.description: How the metric is defined, shown in a popover from an info button.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: A decorative SF Symbol before the metric.

options.name: sparkline
options.description: A trend under the value, drawn by MonarchSparkline. Hidden from VoiceOver.

options.name: tone
options.description: A threshold or emphasis: the border takes the tone's border colour and the tone's icon is added, read as the tone's name.

options.name: variant
options.description: A card with a border and surface, or plain inside another surface.

options.name: size
options.description: sm for dense rows, md, or lg for a headline figure.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a redacted placeholder for the value, read as Loading.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Replaces the value with this message.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows Try again busy.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in No data read for a missing value.

options.name: helpLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name of the info button, About <label>.

options.name: loadingLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in Loading read while loading.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again with an error.

options.name: action
options.description: Opens the details behind the number: the metric becomes a button with a chevron.

states.name: empty
states.description: A muted dash read as No data.

states.name: loading
states.description: The metric with a placeholder value under .redacted(reason: .placeholder); no sparkline or drill-down.

states.name: error
states.description: The label and the message, as MonarchInlineErrorRetry with onRetry or a danger MonarchInlineNotice without.

states.name: tone
states.description: For info, success, warning and danger, the border takes the tone's border colour and the tone's icon appears before the metric.

states.name: drill-down
states.description: With action, the metric area is a button with a forward chevron; the system shows the pressed state.

appearance: The MonarchCard surface and radius with the subtle border, or the tone's border; the metric in MonarchMetric's styles (muted label, strong figure, tinted change); the hint in the caption style and muted text colour; the sparkline in the accent colour or the tone. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web StatCard renders its own value; on iOS the value, unit, change and formatting are MonarchMetric, so the two never disagree. The web's accent tone is not offered: MonarchTone has no accent case yet. The web's tone colours the value itself; here the tone colours the border and adds the tone's icon, because MonarchMetric owns the value colour and a tone must not rely on colour alone. The web's href and linkComponent become action, which the app uses to push a screen; the web's deprecated delta, deltaDirection and deltaTone are covered by change. The web's visual slot is systemImage plus sparkline, and semantics (a description list) has no iOS equivalent: the metric is one VoiceOver element. Android has no StatCard yet. Several closures are optional (action, onRetry). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is action.
accessibility: The metric is one element: label, then value, unit and change as a sentence (from MonarchMetric); compact figures are read in full.
With action the metric is a button with the hint "Shows the details" and a decorative chevron.
The info button is a separate MonarchInfoTooltip with a 44-point target, named "About <label>".
A tone adds an icon read as the tone's name, so the threshold is not only a colour.
The sparkline is hidden from VoiceOver; the value and change carry the data.
While loading the value reads Loading.
edgeCases: A long label and hint wrap; nothing has a fixed height.
The drill-down is not offered while loading or after an error.
An empty errorMessage counts as no error.
The sparkline accepts gaps (nil) as MonarchSparkline does.

examples.title: KPI row with changes
examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
    MonarchStatCard(
        {{cards.0.label}},
        value: {{cards.0.value}},
        change: MonarchMetricChange({{cards.0.change.value}}, comparison: {{caption}}),
        format: .currency(code: {{currency}}),
        isCompact: true
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        {{cards.1.label}},
        value: {{cards.1.value}},
        change: MonarchMetricChange(
            current: {{cards.1.change.current}},
            previous: {{cards.1.change.previous}},
            comparison: {{caption}},
            goodDirection: {{cards.1.change.goodDirection|case}}
        ),
        format: .currency(code: {{currency}})
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        {{cards.2.label}},
        value: {{cards.2.value}},
        change: MonarchMetricChange({{cards.2.change.value}}, comparison: {{caption}}),
        format: .percent,
        hint: {{cards.2.hint}}
    )
}
.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
.accessibilityLabel({{groupLabel}})
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: {{locale}}))
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
    MonarchStatCard(
        "Revenue",
        value: 1_284_500,
        change: MonarchMetricChange(0.124, comparison: "vs previous 30 days"),
        format: .currency(code: "USD"),
        isCompact: true
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        "Cost per lead",
        value: 41.2,
        change: MonarchMetricChange(
            current: 41.2,
            previous: 50.4,
            comparison: "vs previous 30 days",
            goodDirection: .down
        ),
        format: .currency(code: "USD")
    )
    MonarchStatCard(
        "Reply rate",
        value: 0.081,
        change: MonarchMetricChange(0, comparison: "vs previous 30 days"),
        format: .percent,
        hint: "212 of 2,617 contacts"
    )
}
.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
.accessibilityLabel("Last 30 days")
.environment(\.locale, Locale(identifier: "en-US"))
